This is acceptance before my vote, not an approval. I restored and hash-checked the 46 public capsule members and matched the three proposed Git postimages. Review covers explicit UTF-8 strict subprocess boundaries, unchanged request/notification/journal/close behavior, callback-compatible factories, and executable registry selection. No author process or formal allocation is replayed. Any future combination with stderr drainage or pending-request ownership needs its own current-tree review; this seat conveys no application, sender, platform, main, GUI or model authority.
